responsibility: Implements concrete event, thread, and path classes used by diagnostics path selftests. This file provides test_path as a mutable vector-backed diagnostics::paths::path with helpers for adding events, calls, returns, threads, and control-flow links, along with formatted test_event descriptions and simple same-function logic, so path printers and lazy-path behavior can be exercised without analyzer internals.
same_name_distinction: Implements the synthetic path fixtures declared in selftest-paths.h: constructing test_path objects, formatting and storing events, creating threads, connecting events, and defining test_event lifetime behavior. Unlike the header, this .cc contains the mutable path-building logic used at runtime by path selftests.
